title: Addendum
description: Adding new blocks to fit your ender palette!
body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/AMgVM47.png)

Addendum is a port of the Additional Ender Blocks mod by cleverpanda714, which is allowed under the license. It focuses on expanding the number of blocks available for end-themed builds! This mod requires **[Differentiate](https://modrinth.com/mod/differentiate)**. Includes, but is not limited to: - stairs, slabs and walls for end stone! - a new *polished* end stone set! - purpur bricks! - shulker blocks and swirls, based on the shulker textures! - automatic compatibility for both Quark (midori) and Lepton (pressure plates and buttons) when loaded! Check out the gallery for more information.   **Credits:** cleverpanda714, for making the original mod Evtema3, for making some of the original textures 8HP, for some updated textures Rexschwert, for the Russian translation
